crossRefs.note: They ran and got him there. When he stood among the people, he was higher than any of the people from his shoulders and…
When they had come, he looked at Eliab, and said, “Surely Yahweh’s anointed is before him.”
Jesus said to them, “Can the friends of the bridegroom mourn, as long as the bridegroom is with them? But the days will…
He who has the bride is the bridegroom; but the friend of the bridegroom, who stands and hears him, rejoices greatly…

translations.web: When they saw him, they brought thirty companions to be with him.
translations.bsb: And when the Philistines saw him, they selected thirty men to accompany him.
translations.kjv: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions
translations.asv: And it came to pass, when they saw him, that they brought thirty companions to be with him.
